title: Venus programming contract v1
objective: Promote a small set of backend-parameterized programming and ABI rules instead of promoting workload-specific failure stories.

contract_rules.statement: Resolve physical rows, lanes, bank width, memory limits, output limits, descriptor widths, task-call ABI, transfer alignment and engine paths from the selected backend manifest. Never encode Venus2 values as universal Venus syntax.
contract_rules.exclusions: A manifest value is not automatically valid for another backend or RTL digest.

contract_rules.statement: Treat the declared extended-vector length as capacity, pass the intrinsic's active element count explicitly, and express vreturn lengths in bytes. Keep i8/i16 element counts, allocation sizes and return byte lengths distinct.
contract_rules.applicability: Venus C intrinsic and task-return code
contract_rules.exclusions: Uncommon intrinsics must still be checked against the active headers.

contract_rules.statement: Use vbarrier by default at the canonical vector-to-scalar visibility boundary before VSPM_OPEN and bounded volatile access through vaddr. Ordinary register-vector dependencies do not justify a barrier. Classify every other barrier as a backend_workaround with an adjacent scope and focused regression.
contract_rules.exclusions: Whether a particular scratch-memory dependency needs a fence is backend-scoped empirical knowledge, not universal syntax.

contract_rules.statement: Track BAS ordinal, ELF VMA, combined-image offset, runtime LSU/VSPM address, descriptor address and temporary-pool offset as distinct domains. Do not infer that vaddr exposes later physical rows of an extended vector unless the selected backend proves that scalar range.
contract_rules.applicability: task inputs, temporary vectors, scratch and task boundaries
contract_rules.exclusions: A pointer spelling or adjacent allocation is not address-contiguity evidence.

contract_rules.statement: Treat the C signature, BAS positional call, compiler-serialized task inputs, Scheduler descriptors and ordered vreturn value/length pairs as one ABI. Confirm parameter placement in emitted code and reject stack arguments when the backend does not support them.
contract_rules.applicability: Venus task generation and DAG integration
contract_rules.exclusions: Successful Gem5 execution does not prove Scheduler or RTL task-call ABI compatibility.

contract_rules.statement: Preserve logical DAG input types for ownership and hydration, then map them explicitly to backend physical source categories. Never truncate a logical type to the configured descriptor width; reject unsupported logical types before firmware handoff.
contract_rules.exclusions: The physical bit width and mapping values are backend-profile data.

contract_rules.statement: Audit output count, exact vreturn byte length, allocation/alignment, downstream descriptor length and DMA beat size independently. Preserve one semantic tensor as one output unless semantics, a focused compatibility probe or measured DAG performance justifies partitioning.
contract_rules.exclusions: DMA beat size is neither output-port capacity nor proof that partial final beats are supported.

contract_rules.statement: Use #pragma temp pin to express that an otherwise unconsumed, non-DAG-return task output must remain an observable validation checkpoint. Pinning does not create a dependency, change scheduling, export a DAG return or pin a vector register, and it can increase temporary-memory pressure.
contract_rules.applicability: partial DAGs and deliberate intermediate checkpoints
contract_rules.exclusions: The interaction with implicit auto-pin and redundant-warning policy remains unresolved.

excluded_backend_specific_claims: Venus2 numeric limits and absolute addresses
the current Polar scratch fence locations

shadow_patch.requirement: Generate one exact patch against the recorded foundation digest after rule-by-rule human scope review.

promotion_conditions: Approve or defer each contract_rules item independently
Generate an exact shadow patch containing only accepted items
Run syntax/ABI positive and negative regressions for rules exercised by executable gates
Bind the human receipt to this proposal digest, shadow-patch digest and base digests
Create a reversible local commit; do not push or merge without separate approval
source_evidence_policy: The original workload-specific proposals remain immutable evidence records and are not individually promoted.
